scriptLines: gender = case(lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'M', lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'F', toString(null())),

dob_raw = coalesce(toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM-dd-yy')),

insurance_provider = case(isNull(insurance_provider) || trim(insurance_provider) == '', 'Sin Seguro', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'aetna'), 'Aetna', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'blue'), 'BlueCross', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'cigna'), 'Cigna', lower(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'medicaid', 'Medicaid', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'medi'), 'Medicare', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'united') || lower(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'uhc', 'UnitedHealth', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'self'), 'Self-Pay', trim(insurance_provider))) ~> dclimpiezabase

dclimpiezabase derive(date_of_birth = iif(isNull(dob_raw), toDate(null()), iif(year(dob_raw) >= 2030, addMonths(dob_raw, -1200), iif(dob_raw > currentDate() || dob_raw < toDate('1900-01-01'), toDate(null()), dob_raw))),

phone = case(length(phone_digits) == 10, substring(phone_digits, 1, 3) + '-' + substring(phone_digits, 4, 3) + '-' + substring(phone_digits, 7, 4), length(phone_digits) == 11 && left(phone_digits, 1) == '1', substring(phone_digits, 2, 3) + '-' + substring(phone_digits, 5, 3) + '-' + substring(phone_digits, 8, 4), toString(null()))) ~> dcfechasytelefono
